title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maidragon S: Nippon no Omotenashi (Attend wa Dragon desu)
justification: AniList 136436 has 1 OVA episode (2022-01-19; 'Japanese Hospitality (The Attendant Is a Dragon)'). AniDB 14678 S1 'Extra Episode: Japanese Hospitality (The Attendant Is a Dragon)' (番外編 ニッポンのおもてなし) is dated 2022-01-19; the node's pair ;1-30; lands it on TVDB 318893 0x30 'Japanese Hospitality (The Attendant Is a Dragon)' (abs 27, 2022-01-19). The other 2022-01-19 special, S22 'Mini Dra EX5: Training' (named by the detail), goes to 0x29 'Mini Dragon EX5: Training' by the range row, so the date-only collision is resolved by titles.
